items.title: Why Amgen’s Pipeline Just Got More Interesting
items.summary: Amgen Inc. (NASDAQ:AMGN)’s experimental drug dazodalibep met the main goal of a late-stage trial for Sjögren’s disease. After 48 weeks, patients with moderate-to-severe disease activity showed statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements.
